data.notes: March 2027 underground listings are still sparse this far out, so this only includes dated, source-backed genre/club-oriented events found on ticketing/listing or promoter pages.

events.title: F*CK FANTASM All Night Long – Mexico City
events.summary: Rebels/Reu-presented hard-techno all-night-long takeover by FANTASM at Sala Urbana, running 23:00–05:00 with external ticketing and a stated techno focus.

events.title: I Love Reggaeton 2027
events.summary: I Love Reggaeton is confirmed for March 6, 2027 at Estadio Fray Nano de Beisbol, with De La Ghetto, Kevin Roldan, Alexis y Fido, Ivy Queen, Trébol Clan, Jory Boy, Baby Rasta y Gringo and more listed. The official tour site also lists the CDMX stop on March 6, 2027.

events.title: JUNGLE - World Tour 2027
events.summary: Jungle are confirmed at Palacio de los Deportes on March 19, 2027 at 8:00 p.m., with Sports listed on the bill. Ticketmaster lists the CDMX show as part of JUNGLE - World Tour 2027.

events.title: Love The 90s Mexico 2027
events.summary: Outdoor 90s dance/eurodance nostalgia festival with Haddaway, Robin S, Corona, Black Box, Ultra Naté, Sonique, Whigfield, Safri Duo, Proyecto Uno and Reel 2 Real at the 5,000-cap Estadio Fray Nano.

events.title: Lola Índigo
events.summary: Lola Índigo is confirmed for March 25, 2027 at 9:00 p.m. at Teatro Metropólitan. Ticketmaster describes the Spanish artist's show as pop urbano and lists the single Mexico City date.

events.title: TOMORA – Mexico City Show
events.venueName: Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes
events.summary: Electronic live show from TOMORA, the project pairing AURORA with Tom Rowlands of The Chemical Brothers, confirmed for Pabellón Oeste at 20:30 via Ticketmaster México.

events.title: TOMORA
events.venueName: Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes
events.summary: TOMORA is confirmed at Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes on March 26, 2027 at 8:30 p.m. Ticketmaster classifies the artist under electrónica and lists the Mexico City concert date.

events.title: Ke Personajes
events.summary: Ke Personajes are confirmed for March 27, 2027 at 8:00 p.m. at Pepsi Center, Mexico City. The Ticketmaster event page lists the date, venue, ticket sale windows, and artist lineup.

events.title: Peter Hook and the Light
events.venueName: Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes
events.summary: Peter Hook and the Light are confirmed at Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes on March 5, 2027 at 8:30 p.m. Ticketmaster lists the Mexico City date as part of the artist's 2026-27 concert dates.

events.title: Kid Francescoli - A Kind Wave Tour
events.summary: Kid Francescoli is confirmed for March 21, 2027 at 8:00 p.m. at Foro Puebla. Ticketmaster lists the show under the artist's Mexico concerts for A Kind Wave Tour.

events.title: Conociendo Rusia
events.summary: Conociendo Rusia is confirmed for March 27, 2027 at 8:00 p.m. at Auditorio BB. Ticketmaster lists the CDMX date among the artist's Mexico concerts.

events.title: Pol Granch
events.summary: Pol Granch is confirmed for March 26, 2027 at 9:00 p.m. at Teatro Metropólitan. Ticketmaster lists the date and notes the show as a special Mexico City presentation for the Spanish pop artist.

events.title: SYML
events.summary: SYML is confirmed for March 6, 2027 at 9:00 p.m. at Teatro Metropólitan. Ticketmaster lists the Mexico City date under the artist's Mexico concerts.
